name: wizzist
description: Personalized study plans and a lasting learning record for a connected Wizzist student account: read today's step and class context, propose a plan, save selected practice, and return to the next step.

planner_key.title: Wizzist planner key
planner_key.description: A personal planner key from Wizzist Settings, under AI assistants (wzk_...). It lets Claude Code read today's steps and your plans, and, if the key allows it, propose a plan. Leave it empty to use only the learning connector.
